reviews.title: Unsafe. Keep your kids away.
reviews.text: All of the moderation is done by AI, so things are removed that shouldn’t be while vile things are allowed. Pornographic profile pics are allowed despite repeated reports. There’s a guy with a picture of a nude man and woman having sex. Multiple people have reported it and it hasn’t been removed. Someone make a sexually explicit threat toward me and I was told it didn’t violate the rules. I simply responded “Ew” and that was removed and I was told that I had violated their rules. Young children are allowed all over the app despite that being against the rules. Many have made comments where they admit to being under the age of 13, but nothing has come of the reports. It really is just as toxic as twitter. I’ve had my life threatened multiple times and I am punished for telling them to leave me alone, but their very explicit threats are allowed to remain. I’ve had several people make multiple accounts to keep harassing me after I block them. Keep your kids off of here. It’s incredibly unsafe. There are a lot of decent people, but the AI favors the stalkers and the pedophiles looking for victims.

reviews.title: Nothing Special
reviews.text: This app is expected to be the alternative to Pinterest, but instead it combines all the worse features of instagram and tik tok. The content is boring, generic influencer slop targeted to young teens. I’m sure if you stuck it out, the algorithm would eventually lead to interesting content (if you can tolerate the weird comments). I also do not recall allowing the app access to my location. Upon opening the app for the first time, it showed me content relating to the state and city I live in. It is also difficult to delete your account. To do so, you have to go through tik tok, which I do not have an account with. I also do not remember setting up a password for my Lemon8 account, making it impossible to delete the account. Lemon8 could be something unique, but it has no intention of reinventing the wheel, just regurgitating the worse of social media.
